config.label: The folder of the store
config.description: The folder of the store. The default is ~/.polite-crawler.

config.label: An email address or URL for the From header of each request
config.description: An email address or URL for the From header of each request.

config.label: Set it to 1 to let the crawler fetch loopback, private and link-local addresses
config.description: Set it to 1 to let the crawler fetch loopback, private and link-local addresses. The default refuses them.

config.label: Set it to 1 to let user_provided read a page that refuses AI input when the client cannot ask the user to confirm
config.description: Set it to 1 to let user_provided read a page that refuses AI input when the client cannot ask the user to confirm.

config.label: The file of an Ed25519 private key (PKCS#8 PEM or JWK)
config.description: The file of an Ed25519 private key (PKCS#8 PEM or JWK). The crawler signs each request with it (Web Bot Auth). It needs POLITE_CRAWLER_SIGNATURE_AGENT.

config.label: Where a site finds the public key of POLITE_CRAWLER_SIGN_KEY: the https origin of the key directory, or the URL of a JSON Web Key Set
config.description: Where a site finds the public key of POLITE_CRAWLER_SIGN_KEY: the https origin of the key directory, or the URL of a JSON Web Key Set.
